definitions.explanation: A person who works at a bank. The term covers all bank staff from tellers to office workers, but does not include executive management.

examples.japanese: {行員|こういん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開設|かいせつ}→開設：14595_kaisetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I asked a bank employee to open an account.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行員|こういん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: She works as an employee at a major bank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行員|こういん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The bank clerk at the counter politely explained the procedure to me.

notes:
A compound of {行|こう} (abbreviation of ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧, bank) and {員|いん} (member, staff). This word follows the common Japanese pattern of abbreviating an organization name and adding {員|いん} to refer to its employees, similar to ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧ (company employee) and ⟦{駅員|えきいん}→駅員：05503_ekiin⟧ (station staff).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧{行員|こういん}: bank employee (with full form for clarity)
- ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行員|こういん}: teller, counter clerk
- {行員|こういん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{勤|つと}める→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧: to work as a bank employee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{銀行員|ぎんこういん}→銀行員：05058_ginkouin⟧: bank employee — the full, unabbreviated form; slightly more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧: company employee — the parallel term for general companies
- ⟦{局員|きょくいん}→局員：24361_kyokuin⟧: post office employee — the equivalent for postal workers
- ⟦{工員|こういん}→工員：04181_kouin⟧: factory worker — a homophone with completely different meaning; uses {工|こう} (craft, factory) instead of {行|こう} (bank)
